title: tracking: console list page and shell layout refresh after the 2026-10-15 prototype — parent of #12423, #12427, #12440 and #12429, with the items not yet carded
body:
Filing gate ④ (a coordination node: one parent, its child cards listed below) on the maintainer's instruction, gate ③ (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill), verbatim: 「这些任务都是你处理吗？ 是否建议开专题卡」 and, on the seat's recommendation of a `tracking` parent, 「同意专题卡」. The design every child follows is the maintainer-approved prototype at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f (private to the maintainer; artboards: the 1440 main board, the 1024 laptop board with the collapsed icon rail, the 390 phone board that keeps today's phone shape). The maintainer's framing of the whole, verbatim: 「我关心的是平台整体界面的布局优化」 and 「crm 本身的元数据不重要，我关心的还是平台的基础能力」 — every child changes `@object-ui/*` platform behaviour; the two HotCRM cards of the audit round (below) are listed here for the record and change HotCRM view metadata only.

**Reader who acts:** nobody on this card itself — it is not dispatchable and carries no `pm:queue`. The `domain:ui` lane's seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9800, vacant since the filing session clocked out) claims and dispatches each child from `pm:queue` on its own, one dev at a time, and keeps the checklist below current at each round boundary. The maintainer adds follow-ups as comments here; the seat turns each into a child card.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T07:25Z): "tracking parent card console list page shell layout sidebar favorites toolbar Display prototype" → 37 total, top 8 read: the four children (#12440, objectstack-ai/objectui#12423, objectstack-ai/objectui#12429, objectstack-ai/objectui#12427) and four unrelated closed cards (#12211 browser-pass list card, objectstack-ai/objectui#11572 InterfaceListPage projection, objectstack-ai/objectui#5720 AppSidebar observation, objectstack-ai/objectui#3946 app-shell.mdx). No open or closed parent for this prototype. None is this card.

## What the prototype changes, and where each piece lives

The list page on a 1440 px desktop spent about 290 px of chrome before its first row and offered up to twelve toolbar controls at once; the sidebar had two "keep this handy" controls that landed in different places, and its collapse toggle sat at the bottom-left of a long navigation. The prototype's shape: four toolbar controls (Filter · Sort · Display · Search) with everything else inside Display; saved-view tabs sized to the width, on the same row as those controls; one leading cell per grid row (number, checkbox on hover); a one-row page header; one Favorites section at the top of the sidebar fed by a hover ⋯ menu on each item and by the page's overflow menu; the collapse toggle in the app bar's left slot at every width; the phone shape unchanged.

## Children of the prototype round (all landed)

- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12423 — list page: the Display popover, width-fitted view tabs, the leading cell, the one-row header. MERGED 2026-10-15T07:29Z as `a2225f9` (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12436; ACCEPT + contract review PASS on head `4ba299c`).
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12427 — Favorites: the sidebar ⋯ menu, the top Favorites section, the two `NavigationRenderer` props, the list header ⋯ entry, the record overflow entry, the i18n keys: PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12443 MERGED 2026-10-15T08:37Z as `a8e5b73`. The remainder (the record header star draws only where the host wires a toggle, `@object-ui/components` `containers.tsx`): PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12465 MERGED 2026-10-15T10:37Z as `5c4deb5`.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12440 — the saved-view tab strip and the four controls share one row (`ListView` takes a leading toolbar slot as a host prop; the console passes `ViewTabBar` into it). PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12473 MERGED 2026-10-15T12:34Z as `d4bc81e`. Left behind one regression, objectstack-ai/objectui#12518 below.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12429 — the sidebar collapse toggle moves from the sidebar footer to the app bar's left slot at every width. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12466 MERGED 2026-10-15T10:29Z as `e869e41`.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12457 — closed, not planned, on the maintainer's ruling 「设计参照 PNG 进仓库 不应该，你放在 issue 上就可以」: the design reference stays on the reference page linked above and in chat; nothing lands in the repository.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12461 — app bar: the object breadcrumb after the app switcher goes, the Preview badge stays beside the app name, Edit app is an icon button at every width. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12469 MERGED 2026-10-15T11:12Z as `d9d9d98`.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12462 — list page: a selection-scoped `list_toolbar` action (the demo's Add to Campaign) leaves the header for the selection bar that floats when rows are selected, next to the view's `bulkActions`; the header keeps New, Import and ⋯. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12494 MERGED 2026-10-15T13:47Z as `d35cfbf`.
- [x] objectstack-ai/objectui#12463 — list page: on desktop the table scrolls inside the page under its sticky header while the chrome and the footer stay put; at 1024 the first and the actions column stick and a right-edge shadow says more columns follow. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12479 MERGED 2026-10-15T11:56Z as `c950345`.

Acceptance of the round: the filing session's post-merge screenshots at 1440 / 1024 / 390 were shown to the maintainer in chat; the gaps the maintainer named became objectstack-ai/objectui#12461, objectstack-ai/objectui#12462 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12463 above, now landed.

## Children of the audit round (filed 2026-10-15T14:31Z)

On the maintainer's instruction 「更新最新的代码，完整的测试一下前端用户界面的各项功能，评估还有哪些可以改进的地方」 the filing session audited the HotCRM console on `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR; 93 screenshots at 1440 / 1024 / 390, light and dark, en and zh-CN; every function exercised worked, zero runtime errors). The maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」 and then 「你创建的卡片可以放到队列让 ui 车道自己认领吧？」: every card below sits in `pm:queue` with no assignee for the lane's seat to claim; nothing is dispatched by the filing session. The quota of three cards per fire is exceeded on that word, which approved the report's list as a set.

- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12518 — p1, regression of objectstack-ai/objectui#12440: the tab strip inside the toolbar's leading slot folds to one tab + "N more" at 1440 because the bar's root does not grow (`flex-grow: 0`), so the width the fit is derived from is its own content's. `@object-ui/plugin-view`, size S.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12520 — p1: the sidebar ⋯ menu's Design entry opens the metadata-admin page (which calls a packaged object locked) while the app bar's Edit app opens Studio's Data surface; one derivation, one destination. `@object-ui/app-shell`, size S.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12521 — p1: a create/edit dialog with no authored layout opens at 95vw with one column of unequal field widths; a bounded dialog with a two-column field grid. `@object-ui/plugin-form`, size M.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12523 — p1: the record page's highlight strip clips its last values at 1440 and mixes two layouts at 390; values truncate with a tooltip or wrap, one phone layout. `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, size S.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12530 — p1: the bell's Activity feed and the home card list platform events (JWKS keys, data migrations, every login) to business users; the feed reads the app's business objects only. `@object-ui/app-shell`, size S–M.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12526 — p2: object lists, dashboards and component pages draw three page-header shapes and dashboards keep an app-bar crumb; one `PageHeader` for all three. `@object-ui/app-shell`, size M.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12527 — p2: a History row with no actor at all reads "Unknown user"; it reads System. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` + i18n, size S.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12529 — p2: the record header ⋯ menu's system entries carry no icons and Edit has no header control when the row is full. `@object-ui/app-shell`, size S.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/objectui#12528 — p2, family card: the view description's own row, the sort popover's standing note, the metric card's four-line stack, the two-row list footer. `plugin-list`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-dashboard`, size M.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2122 — p2, HotCRM metadata: Lead Pipeline and Lead Cards split the name into two lines and repeat it; `full_name` as the card title; Lead Calendar keys on `created_at`. Claimed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat, not this lane.
- [ ] objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2123 — p2, `pm:blocked` on objectstack-ai/objectui#12474 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12505: the grid views declare no `userActions.hideFields`, so Display has no column chooser; declared once the Hide Fields persistence fixes are released.

Not carded from the audit, by the filing gate: the dev-mode boot cost (3,303 module requests on a full reload; a production build measurement first), the pre-login 401s and the `auth/organization/list` 404 on boot, and the 2-second "Connected" flash of `ConnectionStatus` (by design).

Parallelism: objectstack-ai/objectui#12518 (`plugin-view`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12521 (`plugin-form`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12523 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12527 (`plugin-detail`, different files), objectstack-ai/objectui#12528 (`plugin-list` / `plugin-grid` / `plugin-dashboard`) touch disjoint packages and run in parallel. objectstack-ai/objectui#12520, objectstack-ai/objectui#12530, objectstack-ai/objectui#12526 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12529 all edit `@object-ui/app-shell`: objectstack-ai/objectui#12520 (`SidebarItemMenu.tsx`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12530 (`hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `layout/ActivityFeed.tsx`), objectstack-ai/objectui#12526 (`layout/PageHeader.tsx`, `views/DashboardView.tsx`, `layout/AppHeader.tsx`) and objectstack-ai/objectui#12529 (`views/RecordDetailView.tsx`) are different files; the second to land merges `main` again.

## In the prototype, not yet carded

1. The 1024 px laptop board's collapsed icon rail was objectstack-ai/objectui#12429's acceptance, not a card of its own.
2. Per-user persistence of Display settings (density, hidden fields, row numbers) landed as objectstack-ai/objectui#12418 (`caac3b2`), an existing card outside this parent; its remainder is objectstack-ai/objectui#12474 / objectstack-ai/objectui#12505, outside this parent.

## How this parent is kept

The checklist above is the only state on this card; the seat ticks a child when its PR is MERGED and adds a line with the merge commit. Child cards carry `Blocked-by:` lines to each other, not to this parent. Sub-issue links are not written: the fleet-write relay's op table has no sub-issue op and the seat writes GitHub through that relay only, so the task-list references above are the parent–child relation GitHub shows ("tracked by").

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's instruction quoted above.

## Design reference (added 2026-10-15T08:12Z on the maintainer's question 「如何确保车道能严格按照你的设计开发」)

The visual target lives in one page, readable by every session of this account and shareable by the maintainer from its Share menu: https://claude.ai/artifact/JCzrzHxTxzD4EEKCTtDaNA — the three artboards rendered to PNG (`main-1440.png`, `laptop-1024.png`, `phone-390.png`, fetchable as the page's files), a targets table per child card, the designer's notes verbatim, and the acceptance protocol. The interactive prototype stays at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f. Text beats picture: a child card's acceptance list is the spec a dev builds and a seat reviews against; the images show the shape; where they disagree the card wins and gets fixed. The audit report linked above is the second reference: its figures are what each audit-round card cites.

Pixel facts on the main board (1440 px, Leads list, admin): chrome before the first data row ≈ 183 px (app bar 48, page header 52, view row 47, table header 36); the console on `main` `720f6d4` measures first row y = 207 with the tab row and the toolbar on one row. At 1024 the sidebar is a 56 px icon rail and 4 tabs show with "4 more" (today one tab, objectstack-ai/objectui#12518). At 390 only the view row changes (a current-view picker, icon-only controls); the phone shape is otherwise today's.

How a landing seat proves a child matches: its `## 席位核对` carries browser readings at 1440 / 1024 / 390 against the HotCRM demo (first-row y, the toolbar's control list by test id, the folded tab count), compared with the targets table. How the maintainer accepts after merge: three screenshots of the merged console beside the three PNGs, taken by the session the maintainer designates; differences come back here as comments and become child cards.

Handover: a `domain:ui` PM named by the maintainer takes this parent over; the filing session landed objectstack-ai/objectui#12427 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12443), returned objectstack-ai/objectui#12440 and objectstack-ai/objectui#12429 to `pm:queue` at `priority:p1` in that landing stroke, clocked out of seat 3 with the handover brief on the seat post, and later filed the audit round above without claiming any of it.
